diagnostics.message: Reads a whole Firestore collection with no limit() or where()
diagnostics.why: Cost and load time grow with the size of the collection.
diagnostics.fix: Add limit() or where(), or read once and cache the result.

diagnostics.why: Very long methods are hard to read and test. In Flutter, a long build() rebuilds everything inside it on every setState.
diagnostics.fix: Split it into smaller widgets or methods.

diagnostics.message: Firebase client config key found (Generic secret)
diagnostics.why: Firebase client keys identify your project. They are not secrets by themselves; real protection comes from Firestore/Storage security rules and API key restrictions.
diagnostics.fix: Check your security rules and restrict the key in the Google Cloud console.
